# Nguyen Xuan Vinh

> Senior iOS Engineer & Applied AI practitioner with 10+ years building native mobile applications, currently focused on integrating production AI (LLMs, multimodal processing, on-device ML) directly into iOS apps. Based in Vietnam.

Core skills: Swift, Objective-C, SwiftUI, UIKit. Working knowledge of Rust, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript. Focus areas: NLP and multimodal data processing on mobile, agent runtime infrastructure, spec-driven development.

## Experience

- Senior iOS Engineer, Chợ Tốt (May 2022 – Present): Leads AI-driven mobile development for Vietnam's largest re-commerce platform, including a multimodal AI Rapid Listing feature combining real-time camera processing and on-device ML
- Mobile Engineer, VinHMS / Vingroup (Sep 2019 – May 2022): Built MyVinpearl (1M+ resort guests), the CiTravel booking platform, and the CiOwner management system
- iOS Developer, 2359 Media (Feb 2014 – Sep 2019): Built Singtel TV GO (2018 FIFA World Cup streaming app), NewsLoop, and the official Visit Singapore AR travel guide

## Projects

- [VT Code](https://vinhnx.github.io/VTCode/): Hybrid terminal TUI + web coding interface with WebMCP — open-source coding agent in Rust ([GitHub](https://github.com/vinhnx/VTCode) · [ChatGPT Site](https://vtcode.vinhnx.chatgpt.site/)), MIT licensed (2025 – Present)
- [VT Chat](https://github.com/vinhnx/vtchat): Privacy-first AI chat app with RAG, local-first architecture (2024 – Present)
- [VT.ai](https://github.com/vinhnx/VT.ai): Multimodal AI chat with dynamic conversation routing (2024 – Present)
- [Clendar](https://github.com/vinhnx/Clendar): Minimal SwiftUI calendar app, featured by Apple (2020 – Present)
- [WriteDown](http://vinhnx.github.io/writedown-site/): Markdown editor with cloud sync
- [Humid](http://vinhnx.github.io/humid-site/): Voice-first weather app built on Combine
